steward_relevance: Ryan McClaran (IT operator) and the ward system's digital surveillance apparatus used unauthorized computer access against the steward. § 502(c) criminal prosecution + § 502(e) civil cause of action for compensatory damages + injunctive relief. Device admin control, proxy networks, and SIM swap-enabled account access are all § 502(c)(7) violations (unauthorized access to computer system).
first_step_triage: Document each unauthorized access event: what system was accessed (AT&T account, email, phone), when, by what method, and who had authorization. § 502(c)(7) is the broadest provision — 'knowingly and without permission accesses or causes to be accessed any computer system.' Does not require financial loss for criminal liability.
